name: Mossback
subject: A squat moss-armoured STAG BEETLE guardian, broad domed olive green shell split down its centre like two mossy stones; small forward-facing head, two forked woody mandibles, six dark teal jointed legs, a tiny warm ivory eye. Visually LOW and WIDE, body 26 pixels wide and 17 pixels tall on a 32-pixel square. No mushrooms growing on top, no crown, no wings. Simple humble woodland creature, ominous because of its heavy weight, not cute cartoon. Signature attack: body lowers, shell glints amber, mandibles sweep and ram; shell hinges open to expose a small cyan abdomen only when vulnerable. Death: shell tilts, legs fold and the body settles into a broken mossy husk.

name: Bellkeeper
subject: A TALL thin walking BELLFLOWER guardian. One long bent angular teal stem forms a hooked neck and back, with a single large downward-facing muted violet bellflower for its head like a hanging church bell. Three spare pointed root legs, two very slim hooked leaf-arms, no human face, no eyes, no mushroom cap, no beetle armour. Recognisable elegant upside-down bell silhouette, small pale pistil beneath the bell. Body 19 pixels wide and 27 pixels tall within a 32-pixel square. Looks like a real bellflower grew predatory articulation in a moonlit garden. Signature attack: bell head draws back, interior glints amber, neck whips forward and rings a short spore pulse; then bell droops open exposing a cyan pistil. Death: long stem snaps and bell folds down to the ground.

name: Moon Moth
subject: A MOON MOTH guardian with two enormous sharply stepped leaf-shaped wings and a narrow dark teal hanging body, two short antennae. Muted pale sage/ivory outer wings, dusty deep-blue inner wing shapes, ONE small hollow dark oval on each wing; no decorative micro-pattern. Broad triangular celestial silhouette; two long tapered swallowtail tips curve down. Wingspan 29 native pixels, height 25 pixels within a 32-pixel square. Not a humanoid, not a fairy, not an angel. Body always points right in slight side-three-quarter readable sprite view while wings lift above and behind it. Signature attack: folds wings into a narrow spear, amber thorax warning, snaps them wide and lunges; afterward wings droop exposing a small cyan thorax. Death: wings fray and fold into a small pale dry leaf.

name: Hollow Crown — Elder form
subject: The final boss HOLLOW CROWN reimagined as a spare skeletal ANCIENT ROOT WALKER. A split black-teal tree trunk with a very clear EMPTY diamond-shaped hole through the torso; a jagged three-pronged crown grown from antler-like branches; two long uneven articulated root legs, two thin crooked root arms. Moss only in restrained blocks on shoulders and bark edges. NO human face, NO eyeballs, NO armour suit, NO skull, NO bulky moss monster. Distinctive negative-space silhouette, 25 native pixels wide and 29 pixels tall within a 32-pixel square. Dark ink-teal and bark, a few pale sage edge pixels. Signature attack: crown tips lean inward as a small amber seed appears in the empty chest, arms rear, root-spear sweeps from one arm, then chest opens further with a small cyan seed exposed. Death: crown breaks, chest empties and roots collapse into one dry branch pile. Late-level majesty through silhouette and restraint, not many details.
